root_cause.text: The vulnerability is caused by an off-by-one error in the `init_card` function of the ALSA caiaq driver where the loop bound `len < sizeof(card->id)` permits filling the entire 16-byte stack buffer without reserving space for the null terminator.
root_cause.evidence: The patch fixes this by changing the loop bound to `sizeof(card->id) - 1`, and the CVE description notes that writing 16 non-space characters fills the buffer and overwrites the null terminator, triggering a stack-out-of-bounds read in `copy_valid_id_string()`.
